description.value: Baker's Marvel is a bakery in North Vancouver, operating at a site formerly home to a computer shop called Lab Top Computers. It maintains an active Instagram presence under @thebakersmarvel, suggesting it is an operating independent bakery. Touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver may find fresh baked goods available here.
